_doc: Stage gates of roadmap section 12 with the repository support for each. status: host-verified (checked here without AMD tools or board), partial, ready-to-run (code and commands exist; needs tools/board), not-started, blocked (needs an input outside this repository). A gate passes only on its exit evidence files, never on this table.

gates.title: Archive current folder and freeze SPLICE-V identity
gates.exit_evidence: Source/checkpoint inventory; unchanged older project; requirements and unresolved list.
repository: git clone into ~/projects/splicev (new folder; older projects untouched)
gates.note: paper identity and unresolved list are in the paper seed; checkpoint inventory needs the trained model (artifacts/checkpoints/ is empty)

gates.title: Host and board platform inventory
gates.exit_evidence: Exact device/tool versions; candidate XPFM; Linux/XRT API report; no guessed platform.
gates.note: needs the desktop with Vitis 2025.2 and the booted board

gates.title: One-worker AIE + PL movers + Python
gates.exit_evidence: Hardware bytes exact, repeated frames/reboot, bounded waits.
repository: python3 ps/apps/g02_smoke.py --release artifacts/release/smoke/release.json --repeat 5 (and again after reboot)
gates.note: host side verified: smoke kernel on the mock ADF layer and the app on the emulated device; needs the qualified TE0950 platform

gates.title: Complete manifest and reference primitives
gates.exit_evidence: No deployment-critical nulls; generated ABI/LUTs; arithmetic/branch fixtures exact.
gates.note: dev manifest is complete for bring-up but marked non-deployable: 3 nulls, SYN-01..06 synthetic values and DD-01..19 design decisions remain until G04

gates.title: Arm-(e) model, calibration and integer export
gates.exit_evidence: Hash-bound trained models, DFP32/Db/M comparisons, early hypotheses and Phi dependency closed.
repository: detector/splice_det (model in the seven readout arms of SPLICE-V, training, calibration, QAT, evaluation, diagnostics, export), detector/README.md
detector/hpc/README.md: bash run_splicev.sh check; sbatch run_splicev.sh smoke, then pilot, then the full suite (Arrhenius)
python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_detector_*.py' && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_hpc_*.py'
gates.note: model, training, calibration, QAT, evaluation and export code written and host-tested (PyTorch code forward-only on a numpy stand-in); the Arrhenius suite is tested through a mock Slurm; synthetic-scene run exported (artifacts/trained/synthetic_arm_e, provenance S); Phi is a function of the pre-exchange state (DM-05); Eq. (2) of SPLICE-V is the objective the integer reference solves; pending: the first GPU run (smoke scale), image training, DFP32/Db/M comparisons, the exposure discount of SPLICE-V in the integer reference and on the device

gates.title: One-worker AIE numerical kernels
gates.exit_evidence: All walk/band/forecast/residual elements exact; program and data budgets fit.
repository: make aie AIE_SET=uniform1 AIE_TARGET=x86sim && make aie-sim AIE_SET=uniform1 AIE_TARGET=x86sim SUITE=basic
make aie AIE_SET=uniform1 PLATFORM=... (program-memory report; use split3 if it does not fit)
gates.note: dispatcher bodies bit-exact vs the reference on the host (scalar path); AIE compiler fit and the vectorised paths are unverified

gates.title: PL linkage, gate, posterior and trust
gates.exit_evidence: Exact oracle cases; one-call RTL and repeat/reset tests; measured resource schedules.
gates.note: cores and kernel tops bit-exact vs the reference with g++ (__int128); ap_int<128> HLS path, synthesis and cosim unverified

gates.title: Masked fragment-loop integration
gates.exit_evidence: Same G in both engines; no circular dependency; exact source lists/delta-V/residual.
gates.note: toy slice orchestrated over units + PL engines equals the reference at all six boundaries (reference and emulated device); host-orchestrated mode, labelled so

gates.title: Multiworker partition and memory plan
gates.exit_evidence: Two-/four-/34-worker sequence; sixteen legal tuples documented; no overflow/deadlock.
gates.note: direct-PLIO multiworker graphs are generated; packet-switched 34-worker graph and the partition catalogue (paper does not enumerate the 16 tuples) are open

gates.title: Persistent schedule and priority products
gates.exit_evidence: All H0-H5/G events correct; no r->box dependency; credits/generation tests pass.
gates.note: needs the PL sequencer (device-scheduled mode); packet layouts are generated

gates.title: Native and enhanced full detector
gates.exit_evidence: Six-boundary parity on complete frames, cap cases and forced budget exits.
gates.note: needs G04 model and G09 schedule

gates.title: Timing/resource closure
gates.exit_evidence: Actual platform clocks; no critical DRCs; post-route allocation incl. shell and debug.
gates.note: needs the platform and the full system build

gates.title: Accuracy, load and energy study
gates.exit_evidence: P1-P9 results with source tags, paired intervals, common loads, auditable rail samples.
repository: ps/splicev_ps/measure.py (rail sampling from a user map)

gates.title: Reproducible release
gates.exit_evidence: One manifest/model/platform identity; clean-build logs; deploy procedure; checksum inventory.
gates.note: release identity and bundle tooling exist; a deployable release needs G04-G12
